answer: In a market where agents trade ferrous scrap, an agent called sparrow can trace each seller’s audit thread, but votes on trade disputes are weighted by tokens locked for 30 days, not by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
